mechanism_description: DPL_KR_v2 Sorted Portfolio Learning 5축 paradigm 리디자인. v1 EW collapse 100% (51/51 sig_dates) + TO 17.64 + MDD 65.45% 5축 fail mode를 학술 backbone (5 core papers) 통해 axis-by-axis redesign. Axis 1 Output: 직접 weights → sorted portfolio ranked list + score-proportional sizing (DSPO Zhong 2024 + Zhang 2021 ListMLE) - EW collapse는 paradigm 내에서 expressible failure mode 아님. Axis 2 Architecture: Transformer 165K → Set-Sequence (DeepSet + LSTM + GAT + Score Head) ~30K params (Epstein 2025 permutation-invariant), param-to-data 33:1 → 5-7:1 under-param regime. Axis 3 Loss: -E[r_p] → ListMLE + EVaR SoftMin worst-window + TO-adjusted IR penalty 3-term 합성 (Zhang 2021 + Wood 2026 + Zhang-Wang-Cao 2021). Axis 4 Turnover Control: γ_cost=1.0 weak → 3-layer mitigation = decision-induced ranking clipping + min-max rescaling + partial portfolio adjustment α=0.6 (Wang-Hasuike 2026 KKT). Axis 5 Regime Robustness: single model → EVaR worst-window + Macro Graph Prior GAT (KOSPI 10-sector GICS adjacency) + m4 regime auxiliary feature inherit (Wood 2026 DeePM). 도훈 mandate 2026-05-17 22:30 통합: Champion (2-stage ML+optimizer) vs Challenger (Direct Active Weight Policy) 8-model comparison framework + active-weight neutral Σ(w-b)=0 + TE ≤ 0.08 + sector active ≤ 0.10 + ADV usage ≤ 0.05 + purged walk-forward (López de Prado 2018) + 12 mandatory metric + 6 rejection criteria (FactorAdjustedAlpha > 0 strict / Style exposure R² ≤ 0.7 / Explainability mandate). KR 124 sig_dates × 80 features (FMP family-balanced) × ~1500-2000 stocks panel. Walk-forward 5 windows × purged 1m embargo. Hyperparam 20 random × 5 windows = 100 trials → DSR n_trials=100. Codex Round 5단계 의무. Forge cycle implementation은 Q-Lead confirm 후 진행 (도훈 mandate B.2).
